candidates.change_summary: Replace the conditional so that when random == 0 the pot is set to FEE_AMOUNT (instead of 0) after paying out, changing resulting pot value.
Change the conditional to set pot to msg.value when random == 0 (leaving only the ticket just played in the pot) instead of zeroing it.
Move the pot reset before the transfers so pot is set to 0 before payout, changing the value of pot observed after play.
Delete the pot reset so that pot is not set to 0 after a win, preserving higher pot value after play.
Change the require to allow different msg.value, causing different increments to pot and thus different final pot after play.
Change the required ticket amount so play accepts any value instead of exactly TICKET_AMOUNT by replacing the equality require with a minimum-value require (allowing larger msg.value).
Require exactly the fee amount instead of the ticket amount, making play only accept FEE_AMOUNT and changing pot accumulation and payouts.
Change randomness modulus to 3, altering probability of winning and thus observed pot after play.
Change the condition so payout happens when random != 0 instead of random == 0, inverting winner selection and observable pot changes.
Transfer fee to msg.sender instead of bank, changing final balances and observable pot after play.
Do not reset pot to zero after payout, leaving pot unchanged and thus altering observable pot after play.
After increasing pot, immediately reset pot to zero before randomness, ensuring observed pot after play differs (pot cleared regardless of payout).
Swap order of fee transfer and player transfer so player gets pot then bank gets fee, which can change revert behavior and observable balances/mapping of pot.
